content.text:
The rate quoter now gives up on the carrier after 5 seconds and quotes `FLAT_RATES_CENTS[parcel.zone]` instead. All 33 tests pass: the existing ones plus three I added.

- **Timeout:** the 5 seconds is `RATE_QUOTE_TIMEOUT_MS` in `lib/rates.js`. It covers the whole quote, including retries. Checkout waits at most 5 seconds.
- **Fallback:** it applies when the carrier times out and also when it fails after its retries. A fallback quote is not cached, so the next checkout asks the carrier again.
- **Transport timeout:** `callCarrier` in `lib/carrier.js` now takes an optional `timeoutMs`. The default is still `CARRIER_TIMEOUT_MS` (30 seconds), so labels and tracking are unchanged. Your last commit raised that limit on purpose, because giving up early on labels bought duplicate labels. Lowering it globally would have brought that back, so only rate quotes get the shorter limit.

**Retries after the timeout:** a request that loses the race keeps retrying in the background, because `withRetry` can't be cancelled. Each attempt is now capped at 5 seconds, so that is at most 25 seconds. Rate quotes don't cost money, so I left it. If you want those retries to stop at the deadline, `withRetry` would need a way to cancel.

The new tests cover the timeout, a carrier failure, and the 5-second limit sent to the transport.
